name: The Rolling Stones
hook: The British rock band named after a Muddy Waters song — and still touring.

facts.label: Muddy Waters
facts.statement: The band took its name from "Rollin' Stone," a song by bluesman Muddy Waters.

facts.label: Satisfaction
facts.statement: "(I Can't Get No) Satisfaction" was the Stones' first U.S. No. 1, topping the chart for four weeks in 1965.

facts.label: Keith Richards
facts.statement: Keith Richards is the band's guitarist; he married model Patti Hansen, and Chuck Berry once punched him for touching his guitar.

facts.label: Sticky Fingers
facts.statement: The 1971 album Sticky Fingers had a working zipper on its cover, an idea suggested by Andy Warhol.

facts.label: Sympathy for the Devil
facts.statement: "Sympathy for the Devil" repeats "Pleased to meet you, hope you guess my name."

facts.label: Paint It Black
facts.statement: "Paint It Black" was a 1966 hit that begins with seeing a red door and wanting it painted black.

facts.label: Jumpin' Jack Flash
facts.statement: "Jumpin' Jack Flash" was a 1968 song whose title became a 1986 Whoopi Goldberg spy comedy.
